cohort: Infants enrolled in the New Hampshire Birth Cohort Study (NHBCS) from whom stool samples were collected at approximately 6-weeks (n = 158) and 12-months (n = 282) of age.
finding: The study found an overall association between infant gut microbiome taxonomic profiles and metabolite concentrations, but taxonomic relative abundance was not predictive of metabolite concentrations, possibly due to functional redundancy.
